title: Baseline measures
status_text: Ready. Batch gate waits for RWB-ACE-001
goal: Freeze an agreed baseline of portfolio measures so later epics can prove what they improved
why: Six approved measures (route, age, queue, recovery, time in stage, turnaround), computed from Workbench records and frozen on 2026-11-27.
triggers: Only from a COMPLETED ACE batch

writes.note: computed values; baseline rows frozen = true

stores: Data lake INT-19 extract with trailer and freshness stamp; Power BI; job monitor
rules: BR1: a measure is published only under an approved definition in force
BR2: the baseline is frozen once written; a trigger refuses UPDATE and DELETE
BR3: computed from Workbench records through the owning modules (NFR-065)
BR4: only from a COMPLETED ACE batch
risks: Definition without formula or data product -> whole load refused (MSG-GEN-001)
Baseline published a second time -> refused (MSG-P9-001)
Batch not COMPLETE -> no baseline that night (MSG-P1-001)
example: Business date 2026-11-27: 120 open cases (60 Mortgage, 45 HP, 15 SSME)
